artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan for Duration.lean: DANGLING anchor rows, the duration monoid and factorization-linearity, the twisted-arrow category with its coverage-preserving isomorphism to Int(D), and cluster wiring under the full gate set.

memory_candidates.content: Adding one new module under FormalSystem/ is never a one-file change in BimodalLogic: it forces (1) a DANGLING or pinned row per cited paper anchor in docs/reference/paper-definitions-of-record.md BEFORE any docstring cites it (C15, enforced; REFERENCE_NORMAL_FORM row-before-citation rule), (2) an import line plus a '## Modules' bullet in the directory's sibling aggregator (C24 root closure; the aggregator is a shared touch across every concurrent task in that directory and sits in no task's file_scope, so orchestrate such fronts singly or in pairs), (3) regeneration of FormalSystem.lean via 'lake exe mk_all --lib FormalSystem' (C33 byte-exact; never hand-edit), and (4) a module-table row plus declaration/axiom-footprint entries in the directory README. Plan the anchor rows as Phase 1 and the aggregator/root/README wiring as the final full-tier phase, with the module itself built local-tier in between (unimported, so nothing else can observe it).
